status: Post-pilot all-pair document-only analysis; exploratory, not preregistered
sampling: N original documents with replacement; shared draws for every fixed run and pair in each corpus
fixed_runs: All saved runs and all distinct within/cross-run pairs retain equal weights; no seed-ID resampling
comparisons: All 190 configuration pairs per dataset, irrespective of P/R/profile closeness or CI sign
within_reference: Recompute larger available within-configuration mean in each replicate
zero_denominators: Undefined constituent invalidates the fixed-population mean; each CI reports its own finite replicate count
interval: Percentile 95%; conditional on saved runs; nominal, exploratory, no FWER or equivalence claim
profile_sensitivity: ACL and GENIA independently rebuilt from raw gold/train/predictions with configured-typing applicability correction; maximum/support-weighted summaries remain exploratory, not bootstrap equivalence tests
examples: Every configuration pair; first saved run; first two sorted unique keys per target/direction; no CI selection
